name: multi-scale coupling
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 连接不同离散尺度子结构或接触模型的方法。
usage_overview: 用于连接采用不同离散尺度的结构层，使层间的力与响应能够传递，从而在同一分析中衔接不同尺度的子结构或接触模型。

complete_examples.text: Details of the structural multi-scale coupling method are provided in Fig. 6.
Consequently, multi-scale coupling between layers is employed to complete the modeling.

Vol.:(0123456789) On use of the hierarchical function to achieve efficient and accurate dynamic analysis of vehicle‐slab track coupled systems Liu Pan1 · Lei Xu1,2 · Bin Yan1 © The Author(s) 2026 Abstract To improve the accuracy and efficiency of the vehicle-track dynamic interaction under the framework of traditional finite element method, the hierarchical function has been introduced into the track structure modeling and coupled by multi-scale coupling method in substructural interaction and wheel–rail contacts with high modeling versatility.
